description: The nodes of a scene file: names, classes and hierarchy, with properties when asked. type is the engine class, and a node whose script declares a class_name names it under scriptClass, as scene_node get does. A node that instances another scene names that file under instanceOf, and the nodes listed under it come from that file rather than this one; its editableChildren says whether this scene, or a scene it inherits, keeps values of its own for them (scene_node set editableChildren). The root of a scene inheriting another names the scene it inherits under inherits, and every node that scene or one further down makes names its file under inheritedFrom; this file holds only the values it changes on them. A node in any group answers groups, sorted, from this file and every scene it comes from. Needs no editor: one serving the project answers and says whether it holds unsaved changes to the scene, and with none a headless engine reads the file without making its nodes, so no script of theirs runs (autoloads still start once it has answered, as in every headless call). For the nodes of a game that is running, runtime_inspect tree.

depth.description: How many levels to descend, 0 being the root alone. Default: all. A node at the last level that has children of its own lists none and says how many under childrenNotListed.

includeDefaults.description: List every stored property, defaults included, which turns includeProperties on when it is left out: a Control has about a hundred, and ten of them ran to fifty-seven thousand characters. Default false.

includeProperties.description: Include each node's properties: what the file sets and every value that differs from a new node of its class and script, with defaultsLeftOut counting the defaults left out. On a node another scene makes (an instance, a node inside one, or a node of the scene this one inherits) setHere names the properties this scene's own file sets on it, since the values read the same either way. A TileMapLayer or TileMap whose cells the file sets also answers cellCount, since tile_map_data keeps them as packed bytes, and cellsListedBy, the scene_node get call that lists them. Default false.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

name: scene_tree
title: Scene tree
